name: Wanjiru Kamau
headline: Mid-Level QA / Test Automation Engineer
summary: Detail-oriented QA Automation Engineer with 5 years of experience designing and maintaining automated test suites for web and API applications. Skilled in Python-based Selenium frameworks and integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to improve release quality and speed.

responsibilities: Design and maintain Selenium-based automated test scripts using Python for web applications
Integrate automated test suites into Jenkins CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing
Collaborate with developers to identify and reproduce defects during sprint cycles
Conduct API testing using Postman and Python requests library
Mentor junior QA interns on automation best practices
Executed manual and automated regression tests for e-commerce platform releases
Wrote test cases and maintained test documentation in TestRail
Assisted in setting up initial Selenium automation framework using Python
Reported and tracked bugs using Jira, collaborating with development team on fixes
Performed manual testing on web application modules following test plans
Logged defects and verified fixes across multiple test cycles
Supported senior QA staff in preparing test data and environment setup
